subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the remaining TUI work be documentation/help only, or should OpenClaw expose a supported user-configurable send/newline keybinding surface for openclaw tui?
rationale: Current main already supports newline insertion through pi-tui, but a configurable preference would add public TUI config/API surface under a repository policy that sets a high bar for new config.

options.title: Document Current Behavior
options.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while leaving Enter-to-send fixed.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Define a narrow keybinding config/API surface with docs and tests for default and customized send/newline behavior.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior
recommendation.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while leaving Enter-to-send fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this exact issue and has the strongest current TUI wrapper/docs history signal.
